passband_rule: frequency <= 0.45 * min(in_rate, out_rate), and below output Nyquist
stopband_rule: downsampling only; probe frequency >= output Nyquist + 1000 Hz and below input Nyquist
stopband_comparison_note: Several absolute-dB differences are near the float32 residual floor; compare attenuation lower bounds there rather than using 0.25 dB as a universal floor-level gate.
transition_rule: diagnostic tones above 0.45 * min(rate) and below output Nyquist
scope_note: This is High-preset response coverage over the same 357 ordered supported-rate and +/-1 Hz neighbor pairs used by the Tuneout matrix. It does not certify Good/Fast presets, image rejection for upsampling, transients, or perceptual quality.
